text: 中国人民银行主管的《金融时报》发文称，8月14日，央行发布最新金融数据。业内专家分析，在融资结构多元化的背景下，可淡化对贷款这个单一融资渠道的关注，把贷款和债券融资等合并观察。
text_en: The Financial News, supervised by the People's Bank of China, published an article stating that on August 14, the central bank released the latest financial data. Industry experts analyzed that amid diversified financing structures, attention can be shifted away from loans as a single financing channel, and loans and bond financing can be observed together.
